//: Hand-verified corrections. These beat every heuristic AND the frozen id map, because a person checked the real street and the generator cannot. Keep 'why' filled in: it is the record of what was verified and how. See tools/README.md. 'exclude' drops a stop entirely; 'stations' reassigns one; 'headings' relabels one.

13149.why: One physical pole with two SFMTA ids. 13149 is named '3rd St & Van Dyke Ave' and carries the 91; 17345 is named 'Third Street & Williams Ave' and carries the T. They are 6m apart and both northbound. Verified on Street View. Without this the 91's northbound is split from its own southbound (13150), which is in thirdWilliams.

13254.why: The 37's poles at 14th & Church are their own station, not part of churchMarket. Straight-line they are 25-58m from the J and 22 on Church and the F on Market, but on foot it is several crosswalks and a signal cycle at the five-way Market/Church/14th junction. Verified on the ground.

13255.why: See 13254 - the westbound half of the same pair.

13535.why: 30th & Church is its own station, not part of data.json's churchDay. churchDay's southbound platform 14004 is a southbound-only J stop at Church & Day, a separate place from 30th & Church; its northbound platform 14000 is confusingly named 'Church St & 30th St' in the feed, so any rule that matches on platform names would wrongly merge these. Verified on the ground.

13536.why: See 13535 - the eastbound half of the same pair.

14313.why: The 24's two poles at the Castro/17th/Market junction are one stop: 14313 'Castro St & 17th St' northbound and 14334 'Castro St & Market St' southbound, 17m apart. Without this 14313 clusters with the F's terminus pole 13311 (24m away, '17th St & Castro St'), which data.json lists under castroPlaza, and the 24's two directions land in different stations.

exclude.//: Stops dropped entirely: they will never return a prediction. Judged by a stop's share of the trips run by the routes serving it, NOT by an absolute trip count - the 1X runs only 16 trips and the 30X only 6 in the whole feed, so their stops look rare while being perfectly normal for their route. Everything here is under 0.12% of its route's trips: a single detour trip SFMTA never removed. Several still carry hand-entered names in the feed.
